title: Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager JobManagmentService Improper Access Control Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the JobManagmentService component. The issue results from improper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
